topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines the learning objectives for cancer biology, and frames what the subsequent lectures will cover.

topics.label: Biological foundations and experimental modeling of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the biological basis of cancer as a disruption of cellular differentiation and tissue architecture resulting from accumulated genetic changes, as well as the culture models used to study these properties.

topics.label: Tumor invasion, metastasis, and progression from benign to malignant
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the key clinical and histological features that distinguish benign from malignant neoplasms, focusing on local invasion, metastatic dissemination, and stepwise tumor progression.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature and classification rules
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the standard conventions and notable exceptions used in medical nomenclature to classify benign and malignant tumors based on their tissue origin.

topics.label: Pathophysiological mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the local physical obstructions, systemic complications, and metastatic burdens that cause illness and death in cancer patients.

topics.label: Comparative tumor incidence across human tissues and animal taxa
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine epidemiological patterns of tumor frequency across different human organs and analyze cancer prevalence across other species as a shared vulnerability of multicellular organisms.

topics.label: Clinical screening rationale and organ-specific detection methods
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the principles of early tumor detection alongside the specific clinical applications, successes, and diagnostic limitations of screening programs for various cancers.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and practical reminders
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session by reviewing the learning outcomes and providing housekeeping reminders for the upcoming practical classes.
